title: TestReportSummary
description: A bounded, causal-first projection of one test invocation's output, concise enough for a continuous agent loop while the full stdout/stderr remains available, unmodified, as the referenced EvidenceArtifact. Never returned instead of the full log - only alongside it.

first_causal_failure.description: The deepest "Caused by:" line, or the first recognized failure signature, extracted from the combined output.

tail.description: Bounded, retry-noise-deduplicated tail of combined stdout+stderr.

artifact_id.description: EvidenceArtifact id of the full, untruncated combined log.
